title: Soil Analysis and Crop Cultivation Process Explained

tasks.task_text: Describe the initial steps of soil examination and crop selection.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the initial steps of soil examination and crop selection.
subtasks.text: Farmers examine the soil to determine the appropriate type of crop, such as rice, clay, loomis soil, wheat, alluvial soil, cotton, black soil, joar, sandy soil, and maize.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the initial steps of soil examination and crop selection.
subtasks.text: Farmers then plow the field to prepare the soil for planting.

tasks.task_text: Explain the process of making soil fertile.

subtasks.task_text: Explain the process of making soil fertile.
subtasks.text: Manure and fertilizers are added to the soil to make it fertile.

subtasks.task_text: Explain the process of making soil fertile.
subtasks.text: The exact amount of manure is crucial for crop growth.
Different crops require different amounts of water.
The field is supplied with the right amount of water for irrigation.
Seeds are sprayed with insecticides and pesticides to protect them from diseases.
Using natural or organic manure and biopesticides is recommended for environmental benefits.

tasks.task_text: Outline the harvesting and storage processes.

subtasks.task_text: Outline the harvesting and storage processes.
subtasks.text: Crops are harvested and the grains are stored in granaries.
Unwanted plants, known as weeds, are removed regularly.
Fields must be fenced to prevent animals from grazing.
